name: Hitozuma Cosplay Kissa 2
source:
There is a coffee shop "Sakurai" at a small shopping arcade owned by a beautiful widow, Sakurako. The number of customers is decreasing due to a new amusement park "Ocean Land" built near by. One day an owner of "Ocean Land" brings up the plan to rebuild this small shopping arcade to a big shopping mall. Only Sakurako is opposed to that plan to defend her coffee shop full of good memories with her husband. The condition to stop this plan is to collect more customers than the coffee shop in "Ocean Land" do during summer. And a renewed costume play coffee shop "Sakurai" opens....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090108002541/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003668]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
在一个小型商店街上有一家名为“樱井”的咖啡店，由美丽的未亡人樱子经营。由于附近新建了游乐园“海洋乐园”，顾客数量正在减少。某天，“海洋乐园”的老板提出了将这个小型商店街改建为大型购物中心的计划。只有樱子反对这个计划，要保护这间充满与丈夫美好回忆的咖啡店。阻止这个计划的条件是在夏季吸引比“海洋乐园”咖啡店更多的顾客。于是，焕然一新的cosplay咖啡店“樱井”开张了……
